Both changes are in the form, and it validates with no errors.

- **Main colour:** set to dark green `#1B5E20` (Couleur principale, in Apparence > Thème par défaut). Assisted colour mode is on, so the other palettes are recalculated from this colour when the draft is saved. I did not change the colour in the other themes or set the background or text colours.
- **Menu:** added a "Page libre" item in Barre de navigation > Éléments du menu, pointing to "Nos actions pour la jeunesse" (slug `jeunesse`). I left the label empty, so the menu shows the page's own title. It sits after Accueil and Catalogue de données.

I did not save or publish anything.
